description_for_human: Ontology-kernel embedded multi-modal semantic database unifying 12 data types with live data management
description_for_model: OntoDB is an ontology-kernel embedded semantic multi-modal database that unifies 12 data types (key-value, document, relational, graph, vector, ontology, triple store, time series, spatial, rules, live value, namespace) in a single engine. Features: 7-step atomic write pipeline, incremental OWL 2 RL reasoning, live data lifecycle management with exponential decay, kernel-level namespace isolation, HNSW vector indexing with Tanimoto/Hamming metrics and bit-packed binary fingerprints (1024-bit in 128B). Production-verified at 2.45M molecular fingerprints (21-41ms similarity search). Use this plugin to query, insert, and manage data in OntoDB via OntoQL or SQL.

auth.instructions: Set the ONTODB_API_KEY environment variable with your API key.
